Subject: AcmeHealth / Redwood — Private VPC discovery recap & next steps

Hi Rajiv / Mira — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared set of priorities and next steps. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of pain points & goals
- Data residency & regulatory: certain workloads must remain on-prem or in a dedicated VPC region restricted to US-only data handling.
- Air-gap requirement for PHI-scoped workloads in Phase 2 (no outbound internet from inference hosts).
- Networking constraints: restricted egress, proxy-only internet access, limited peering options, and strict firewall rules managed by your network/security team.
- Key management: customer-managed KMS/HSM requirement for encryption at rest and in-flight key management.
- Performance targets: pilot workload ~200 qps peak, P95 latency target <200ms for text-generation paths.

What Redwood can provide (high-level)
- Private deployment options: VPC-hosted private control plane or on-prem package for air-gapped mode.
- Support for customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit logging.
- Staged approach: pilot in a restricted VPC with NAT/proxy egress, followed by an on-prem air-gapped deployment for PHI workloads.

Action items / next steps
1) Technical deep-dive: propose a 60–90m session next week with your network/security + our solutions/infra engineers to review network diagram and offline image strategy.
2) Send your network diagram and any current egress/proxy constraints (we'll align with Laura and Marissa on checklist).
3) I’ll share a preliminary network checklist and SOC2 attestation docs for your compliance team.

Attachments: network-diagram.pdf (stub)

Proposed times: I’ll follow up with a calendar invite but Wednesday 7/28 or Thursday 7/29 AM PT look good on our side.

Thanks — Camila

Hi Rajiv / Mira — thanks for confirming the call. Some technical notes ahead of the deep-dive to speed the discussion:

Networking & packaging notes
- Required outbound endpoints: control-plane telemetry endpoints (we can support egress via your proxy or allowlist specific IPs). If full air-gap is needed we can push images via an offline media transfer process.
- Ports: inference nodes require outbound to control-plane on TCP 443 (if using managed control plane). For fully private on-prem control planes we can run the control-plane inside your network with no internet egress.
- Image distribution: for air-gapped sites we provide signed OCI images and a transfer checklist (we’ll coordinate MD5/SHA checksums).
- HSM/KMS: Marissa: we support PKCS#11-based HSMs; will need certs and admin contact to test key wrapping flows.

Estimated timeline (ballpark)
- Pilot in restricted VPC (with proxy egress): 2–4 weeks from network approval and image access.
- On-prem air-gapped deployment (Phase 2): 6–10 weeks depending on procurement and HSM integration testing.

Agenda for the tech deep-dive (7/28 11AM PT)
1) Walk through AcmeHealth network diagram and egress/proxy rules (Rajiv / network team)
2) Discuss image distribution process and offline transfer requirements (Laura)
3) KMS/HSM integration touchpoints and cert/key exchange (Marissa)
4) Deployment topology options and rollback/fallback strategies
5) Next steps & mutual action plan (owners + dates)

Action items
- Rajiv: share network diagram and proxy ACLs (EOD Thu)
- Camila: send calendar invite (done) and preliminary checklist (done)
- Marissa/Laura: prepare offline image checklist and HSM integration notes for the call

Looking forward — Marissa Cole
